anna_cs: Quick sync — week1 for HarborWave private deploy. Two blockers: MFA service account still pending, and their audit-log aggregator can't reach our ingest endpoint. Can SE/infra confirm current gate status? Also flagging renewal-risk if preflight slips past EOW. TL;DR: need IAM grant, firewall rules, and SIEM ingest check.

raj_se: On it. Can you paste the latest prereq checklist or ticket refs? I'll run through infra with the customer this afternoon.

maria_ops: Ticket #1427 (firewall rule) is stuck in security review. I've pinged security via that ticket.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket #1427 status update: awaiting-security-review (changed by maria_ops).

sam_sec: We need the CIDR ranges and the owner tag before approving. Also need justification for opening 443 from the SIEM IPs.

anna_cs: CIDR ranges: 10.8.0.0/16 (app), 10.9.0.0/24 (mgmt). Owner tag: harborwave-prod. SIEM egress IPs: 54.210.33.12/32, 54.210.33.13/32. Justification: central SOC ingest for audit aggregation.

raj_se: Thanks. I'll update the ticket and book a 30m validation call at 3:30pm PT. Quick note on KMS: if they can't attach the key policy yet, we can do a short-lived grant for validation. Also fallback for audit delivery — if SIEM can't pull, we'll route events to S3 bucket `redwood-hw-audit` and notify them to grant s3:PutObject for the ingestion role.

anna_cs: Copy. Important: renewal risk flag — customer said their internal SOC2 audit depends on these logs. If ingest isn't validated by next Tue they may delay the renewal conversation. I've set CRM risk to HIGH and added a note. @maria_ops can you capture onboarding feedback and any friction points we see here?

maria_ops: Yep — I'll run a short 3-question post-onboard survey and attach notes to the account. Also adding an \"onboarding-blocker\" tag so AE sees it.

raj_se: One more ask for infra/security — can you provision a temporary KMS grant for principal `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-harborwave` with decrypt permission scoped to validation (7 days)? We just need it to run live prompts during cutover.

sam_sec: We can do a time-limited grant until 2026-12-01. Need the principal ARN (you provided) and a short justification string for the audit. Please add justification to ticket #1427 and I'll attach the grant ARN once created.

anna_cs: I'll confirm justification with the customer and update the ticket now. Call in 30m — thanks everyone :thumbsup:

(links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-1427, call dial-in sent to HarborWave calendar)
